findings.issue: Migration sequence gap in 20260626 batch — jumps from 01 to 22; 21 missing sequence numbers suggesting deleted or renumbered migrations
findings.impact: Migration history ambiguity; Supabase CLI tracking by filename may detect conflicts; potential ordering issues on fresh db.push
findings.fix: Audit migration sequence; renumber with contiguous numbers; verify all migrations apply cleanly from scratch

findings.issue: Feature-flag middleware broken: requireWorkspaceMembership('workspaceId') on paths without :workspaceId param — all feature-flag requests fail with 400
findings.impact: Feature flags completely non-functional across all workspaces
findings.fix: Remove requireWorkspaceMembership from feature-flag routes or add workspaceId as query/body param

findings.issue: No production approval gate — push to main immediately deploys to production without any manual review step
findings.impact: Any code merged to main can deploy to production with zero human oversight
findings.fix: Add environment: production with required reviewers to deploy job

findings.issue: Terraform state key hardcoded with no environment interpolation — dev and prod share the same state
findings.impact: Parallel state operations on dev and prod can corrupt Terraform state
findings.fix: Use ${var.environment} in backend key to isolate environment state

findings.issue: Worker package has no health endpoint, no test script, no logging — completely unobservable
findings.impact: Worker failures invisible; no monitoring or alerting for background job failures
findings.fix: Add health endpoint, structured logging, and basic metric instrumentation to apps/worker

findings.issue: TypeScript types severely out of sync with DB schema — 6 interfaces vs 16 tables; soft-delete fields missing
findings.impact: Type safety gaps across codebase; developers forced to use 'any'
findings.fix: Regenerate types via supabase gen types typescript; add CI drift check

findings.issue: governance.yml and platform.yml workflows broken — reference 5 nonexistent scripts
findings.impact: CI noise on every push; no actual governance enforcement
findings.fix: Fix or disable broken workflows; consolidate into working evaluate_gate.py

findings.issue: Playwright test results directory checkpoints (.playwright-results/) not gitignored
findings.impact: Test artifacts may be accidentally committed, bloating repo size

findings.issue: Runbook references packages/db/sql/migrations/ directory which no longer exists
findings.impact: Operators following runbook will look in wrong directory
findings.fix: Update runbook to reference supabase/migrations/ as single migration source

findings.issue: No loading.tsx in route groups — no Suspense fallback for page transitions
findings.impact: Page transitions show blank screen while data loads
findings.fix: Add loading.tsx with Skeleton components to each route group

findings.issue: No dependabot configuration (.github/dependabot.yml) for automated dependency updates
findings.impact: Dependency vulnerabilities may go unnoticed until manually discovered
findings.fix: Create .github/dependabot.yml with weekly npm + GitHub Actions checks

findings.issue: No CONTRIBUTING.md or PR/issue templates to guide new contributors
findings.impact: Inconsistent PR submissions; higher friction for new contributors
findings.fix: Add CONTRIBUTING.md, PR template, and issue templates

findings.issue: Default droplet size still s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb despite known OOM (documented in AGENTS.md)
findings.impact: New droplets provisioned with undersized spec; OOM under normal load
findings.fix: Update default droplet_size to s-2vcpu-2gb in variables.tf
